test_title: PYST 6: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: During WAVES 2025, Odisha CM mentioned India’s indigenous sports gaining global recognition. Which summit was this statement made at?

options.text: World Audio Visual and Entertainment Summit

solution:
The correct answer is __**World Audio Visual and Entertainment Summit**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• During the **WAVES 2025** event, Odisha's Chief Minister highlighted the rising global recognition of India's **indigenous sports**, such as kabaddi, kho-kho, and mallakhamb.
 
• The statement was made at the **World Audio Visual and Entertainment Summit**, which focuses on promoting India's cultural heritage, entertainment industry, and traditional practices.
 
• The **World Audio Visual and Entertainment Summit** serves as a platform to discuss the intersection of technology, culture, and media, with a special emphasis on India's unique offerings to the global stage.
 
• The summit is known for showcasing India's achievements in various fields, including sports, entertainment, and indigenous practices, thus promoting their worldwide appeal.
 
• India's indigenous sports have gained attention due to their incorporation into international competitions and digital platforms, helping them reach a wider audience.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **World Audio Visual and Entertainment Summit (WAVES):**

 
 
• The summit is a global platform focusing on **media, entertainment, and cultural exchanges**.
 
• It brings together professionals, policymakers, and artists to discuss opportunities in the **audio-visual and entertainment sectors**.
 
• The event is aimed at promoting India as a hub for cultural and entertainment exports, including indigenous sports and traditional art forms.
 
• Key themes include **digital transformation**, global collaborations, and the promotion of Indian culture and heritage.
 
 
 
• **Indigenous Sports in India:**
 
 
• **Kabaddi:** Originating in ancient India, it is now recognized globally, with leagues such as the **Pro Kabaddi League** enhancing its popularity.
 
• **Kho-Kho:** A traditional Indian sport focusing on agility and teamwork, it is gaining international recognition.
 
• **Mallakhamb:** A sport that combines gymnastics and yoga, it has been featured in global fitness and cultural events.
 
 
 
• **Global Recognition of Indian Culture:**
 
 
• India's soft power is enhanced through the global promotion of its **traditional sports, art forms, and cinema**.
 
• Events like WAVES contribute to showcasing India's ability to blend **modern technology** with traditional practices.
 
 
 
• **Technology and Media in Sports:**
 
 
• Digital platforms like YouTube and OTT services have been instrumental in promoting Indian sports globally.
 
• Technological advancements, such as virtual reality, are used to enhance the viewer experience of traditional sports.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Government Initiatives:**

 
 
• The Indian government is actively promoting indigenous sports through programs like **Khelo India** and international collaborations.
 
• Efforts are being made to include Indian sports in global sporting events like the **Olympics** and **Asian Games**.
 
 
 
• **Cultural Impact:**
 
 
• Indigenous sports are not just games but are deeply rooted in India's **history, culture, and social fabric**.
 
• Promoting these sports helps preserve India's **cultural heritage** while also encouraging physical fitness and community bonding.
